artifacts.summary: Draft rule inventory (15 rules) for the four-dimension Typst chapter-quality standard, with blocking/advisory and mechanical/judged classification, deferral map to three existing standards, and an interface-contract draft for the two per-repo checks.

memory_candidates.content: In the typst extension, scripts/typst-element-lint.sh's header (SEVERITY SPLIT section) is the canonical, citable precedent for the BLOCKING/ADVISORY axis used elsewhere in this extension: an unreviewed hard threshold that fires on correct documents gets switched off, so any fresh numeric threshold introduced without a corpus observation must start ADVISORY and say so explicitly. Reuse this rationale verbatim rather than re-deriving it whenever a new typst standard introduces a scored/thresholded rule.

No 'CONFIRM comment' authoring convention exists anywhere in this repository prior to the typst chapter-quality standard (verified by repo-wide grep across agent-system/ and .claude/). When a task description references such a convention as if it already exists, check first -- it may actually be asking the new standard to define it, not merely cite it.
